title: RunIdentifier
description: Fully identifies a deterministic simulation run. Any agent, human, or CI runner replays the exact session from this. The Python runtime is authoritative: given the same identifier it emits an identical event log and identical per-tick snapshots. Godot renders replays FROM this — it never re-simulates for a proof.

world_revision.description: Canonical world revision the run simulates against.

runtime_version.description: bgate_engine sim version; a bump can legitimately change results.

seed.description: Root seed. Named streams derive as hash(seed, stream_name).

input_schedule_hash.description: Hash of the per-tick input schedule (see input_schedule).

asset_manifest_hash.description: Hash of the resolved asset manifest; cosmetic asset swaps that change this are visible.

input_schedule.description: The tick-indexed inputs injected into the run. Hashed into input_schedule_hash.

inputs.description: Action edges/holds for this tick. Names match project.godot input actions.

rng_streams.description: Named streams so cosmetic randomness never perturbs combat.
